turns.text: No, but that's a success for me considering the only ever, the only chess I've ever played was 'Simpsons' chess, when I was a kid and 'Simpsons' chess is not any different rules, it's still the same rules but they all look like The Simpsons, so that you had, like, Marge was the Queen and Homer was the King.
turns.zh: 没有，但对我来说这算成功了，考虑到我唯一玩过的、唯一玩过的国际象棋是《辛普森一家》版的，我小时候玩的，而且《辛普森一家》版国际象棋规则没什么不同，规则还是一样的，只是棋子都长得像辛普森一家的人，所以你有，比如，玛姬是王后，荷马是国王。

turns.text: So I still don't know the names of the real chess pieces because I just called them…
turns.zh: 所以我到现在还不知道真正国际象棋棋子的名字，因为我只管它们叫……

turns.text: Neither do I, to be honest.
I played chess last night, um…
turns.zh: 我昨晚下了国际象棋，嗯……
